name: Sarita Prusty

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sarita Prusty writes poetry and literary criticism. Her review of Toshali Anthology of Love Poems appeared in the June 2026 edition of Literary Vibes, whose contributor note describes a background in teaching English and work in creative writing, translation and criticism. This adds a critical voice to the teaching and performance interests recorded in her Kabita Live biography.

“The First Cry”, her poem here, follows the anticipation of childbirth through passing months, sleepless nights and labour. Its brief lines slow the reader at moments of waiting, then gather towards the newborn’s first sound. The poem gives its emotional weight to that movement from inward life to an encounter with the world.
